# Chapter 3: Pre-Processing and Exploratory Data Analysis

## Dataset Collection

The project utilizes the CMU HotpotQA training set, downloading the raw JSON dataset (540MB) containing 113,779 multi-hop question-answer pairs.

## Data Pre-processing

Preprocessing extracts the raw records and filters out the 8 distractor paragraphs, retaining only the 2 gold supporting paragraphs. This reduces noise and optimizes retrieval. Text is cleaned of zero-width characters and whitespace collapsed.

## Exploratory Data Analysis and Visualisations

Analyzing the chunk distribution reveals an average of 3.2 chunks per document context under a 512-character constraint. Semantic clustering of these chunks via UMAP + HDBSCAN reveals well-separated topics (e.g. film directors, geographical sites, historic events) which are utilized to guide synthetic QA generation.
